Rollouts

A rollout exposes a flag to a percentage of contexts, bucketed by a stable hash of the context's user_id so a user does not flip between variants.

Percentage rollouts

client.rollout("new-checkout", percentage=25)
  • percentage — 0 to 100, required.
  • bucket_by — the context attribute to hash. Defaults to user_id.

Changing bucket_by re-buckets every context, which will move users between variants.
